title: fix(console): the injection assertion reads the plain runs inside long or escaped describe literals, so a .objectstack-sha pin gets a real witness
body:
Fixes #24663
Clause-②: no

The in-build console spec-injection assertion was vacuous at `.objectui-sha` `12dc7b47` and passed the control bundle (exit 0). The cause is in `describeCandidates` (`scripts/console-spec-probes.mjs`): it took only `.describe()` literals of 32 to 160 characters with no escape. Between objectui's `.objectstack-sha` `f4755a68a797` and this tree, the one describe that changed (the flow `runAs` text) is over 160 characters, and its em dash is a backslash-u escape (a backslash, then `u2014`) in the built dist. So both candidate pools came out empty and the stamp recorded `freshWitness: null`.

## The change

- **A second candidate source.** A describe literal the old rule skips is cut at every escape sequence and every quote character. Each run of 32 characters or more is now a candidate.
  - **Why cut at escapes.** An escape can be spelled one way in a spec's dist and another way in a bundle, but the text between escapes is plain characters in both.
  - **Why cut at quotes.** A bundler may re-quote a string and add a backslash before a quote.
  - **Why runs are not cut to 160.** That bound was about a whole literal surviving the bundler. Windows of a changed run would also still be contained in the other spec, and `pickProbe`'s substring rule would drop them.
- **Old candidates are unchanged.** A literal the old rule accepted is still taken whole, so every candidate it produced is still produced. `chooseProbes`, the stamp shape and the cache-hit replay (`check-console-injection.mjs`) are unchanged.
- **The fixture.** Self-test battery 16 in `scripts/check-console-injection.mjs` (16 cases) is shaped like this pin:
  - a `.objectstack-sha` pin, with the reference as objectui's own build of it;
  - each distinguishing literal over 160 characters and carrying a backslash-u escape (a backslash, then `u2014`);
  - a shared literal over 160 characters, and a shared run before the escape;
  - an injected bundle where the dash is emitted raw, and a control bundle where the escape is kept.

  It asserts that the stamp carries the changed run as `freshWitness`, that the assertion exits 1 on the control bundle, and that the good stamp replayed over the control exits 1. The roster floor is 13 → 14.
- **No release workflow and nothing under `.github/workflows/**` changed.** The diff is 2 files under `scripts/`.

## Reverse verification

The fix was committed first. Then the `literalSegments` call was replaced by a comment, and `node scripts/check-console-injection.mjs --self-test` exited 1 with 8 failures. Among them: the control bundle "expected 1, got 0", the witness "expected … got null", and the replay "expected 1, got 0". Restored with `git restore --source=HEAD`, the porcelain was clean and the self-test exited 0 with 100 assertions.

## Proof on a real build (pin `12dc7b47c340`)

PR #24660 has not landed, so `.objectui-sha` on `main` is still `4016370af3c9`. The build ran in a throwaway worktree: this branch at `50f12801` merged locally with #24660's head `0b45222fef`. Nothing from that merge is pushed. I will merge `main` into this branch once #24660 lands.

The build ran `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client... --concurrency=2 && bash scripts/build-console.sh`, which is what `pnpm objectui:build` runs, and it exited 0. It took the `.objectstack-sha` branch, built objectui's own `@objectstack/*` at `f4755a68a797` as the reference (`.stamp.json`: `source: pin`, `sha` `f4755a68a797…`), and packed this tree in through `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT`. Its log:

```
✓ Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it (vendored: @objectstack/spec of objectui's own build of objectstack f4755a68a797).
    present (injected only): " system flows keep system privileges; after an approval decision their attribution user is the decider; user = the human whose act is running this segment: the trigger user until a human decision, the decider after it (RLS-respecting; the nodes after an approval decision run with the decider"
      — 3 of 3 injected-only descriptions are in the bundle
    absent  (vendored only): " not yet rendered] The PARENT record this related list hangs off, bound by a query of its own: an object binding "
      — and all 2 pin-only descriptions are absent
```

The stamp records `skew: true`, `vendoredPin` `f4755a68a797…`, `freshWitness` the run quoted above (was `null`), and `staleDetector` the pin-only run.

| reading | before (`main`'s probes) | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| candidate pools at this pin (injected-only / pin-only) | 0 / 0 | 3 / 2 |
| `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp` on the injected dist | 0 ("nothing assertable") | 0, the witness present and the detector absent |
| `assert-console-spec-injection.mjs` on the **control** bundle | **0**, "no observable skew" | **1**, "still carries the @objectstack/spec of objectui's own build of objectstack f4755a68a797" |
| the injected stamp replayed over the control dist (`check-console-injection.mjs --dist … --require-stamp`) | n/a (null witness) | 1 |

- **The control bundle** is objectui's own build of the pin, with nothing from this tree, built in the same build tree with `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT` unset (`objectstack-pin.mjs status`: "built at the pin f4755a68a797"). The bundle has no stamp.
- **Grep counts over each dist's `assets/*.js`** (`grep -lF`): the full witness is in 1 injected asset and 0 control assets; the full detector is in 0 injected assets and 1 control asset.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-24663-injection-witness`: NOT governed; 134 changed lines.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived **35** commands, and **all 35 exited 0**. The `--ran` reconciliation reports "35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- `pnpm exec eslint` on both files exited 0.
- **No changeset:** the diff publishes nothing from any released package (repo tooling under `scripts/`), as with PR #24532. Label `skip-changeset`.
- **Not measured:**
  - The Console Pin Gate does not run on a PR or in the merge queue. Its first CI run on this change is `main`'s battery after the merge.
  - The 15 pending-changeset families do not apply without a changeset.

## Acceptance notes

- The cache-hit replay labels the stale line "absent (published only)" even when the stamp's reference is a pin build. That label is unchanged here.
- The issue's other suggested source, the metadata-type registry `description:` text (for example the `sharing_rule` entry), is not added. The describe runs alone give a non-null witness at this pin.
